subject: Part-Time Remote Position for USF Students - $450/week
body:
Hello {{firstName}},
Your resume was selected from the USF career database for a flexible, work-from-home position as a Administrative Research Assistant. This role is open to currently enrolled students only and requires just 2-3 hours per day.
Compensation and details:
  • Weekly pay of $450, direct deposit
  • No experience or interview required to start
  • Immediate start after onboarding
To begin, reply to this email with your full name, home address, phone number, and the bank you use so we can set up your payroll. Your first week's equipment check will be mailed to you, which you will deposit and use to purchase supplies from our approved vendor.
Positions are limited and filled on a first-come basis, so please respond within 24 hours to secure your spot.
Regards,
Mr. David Coleman
Hiring Coordinator, Student Employment
